description: HTML source code for a web-based database viewer interface, including CSS styles and JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and UI interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data from server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles user interaction to expand/collapse a database's table list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables belonging to a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data rows of selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds HTML table from data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Returns HTML for individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands/collapses cell content for long text or objects.
